english: not only (usually pairs with 而且)
khmer: មិនត្រឹមតែ
breakdown: 不(not)+但(only) — 'not only'

examples.en: He is not only clever, but also hardworking.

examples.cn: 这里不但干净，而且安静。
examples.en: This place is not only clean, but also quiet.

examples.cn: 我不但会说汉语，还会写汉字。
examples.py: Wǒ búdàn huì shuō Hànyǔ, hái huì xiě Hànzì.
examples.en: I can not only speak Chinese, I can also write characters.

examples.cn: 他不但迟到了，还忘了带书。
examples.py: Tā búdàn chídào le, hái wàng le dài shū.
examples.en: He was not only late, he also forgot to bring his book.

examples.cn: 这个办法不但简单，而且有用。
examples.py: Zhège bànfǎ búdàn jiǎndān, érqiě yǒuyòng.
examples.en: This method is not only simple, but also useful.

breakdown: 而(and)+且(also) — and also

examples.en: This dish is tasty, and also cheap.

examples.py: Tā hěn máng, érqiě hěn lèi.
examples.en: He is very busy, and also very tired.

examples.cn: 她会说汉语，而且说得很好。
examples.py: Tā huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě shuō de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: She can speak Chinese, and speaks it very well.

examples.cn: 这里的东西新鲜，而且不贵。
examples.py: Zhèlǐ de dōngxi xīnxiān, érqiě bú guì.
examples.en: The things here are fresh, and not expensive.

examples.cn: 我认识他，而且我们是同事。
examples.py: Wǒ rènshi tā, érqiě wǒmen shì tóngshì.
examples.en: I know him, and we are colleagues too.

khmer: រថភ្លើងក្រោមដី
breakdown: 地(ground)+铁(iron) — the iron road under the ground

examples.en: I take the subway to work.
Where is the subway station?

examples.py: Zuò dìtiě bǐ zuò chē kuài.
examples.en: Taking the subway is faster than a car.
There are many people in the subway.
This city has no subway.

breakdown: 地(ground, land)+图(picture) — a picture of the land

examples.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì zhāng dìtú.
examples.en: Please give me a map.
I look at a map to find the way.

examples.py: Zhè zhāng dìtú hěn jiù le.
examples.en: This map is very old.
There are maps on the phone too.

examples.py: Méiyǒu dìtú wǒ jiù zhǎo bu dào.
examples.en: Without a map I can't find it.

khmer: ជណ្ដើរយន្ត
breakdown: 电(electric)+梯(stairs) — electric stairs

examples.en: Let's take the elevator up.
The elevator is broken.
The elevator is over there.

examples.py: Zhège lóu yǒu liǎng ge diàntī.
examples.en: This building has two elevators.

examples.cn: 电梯里不要说话太大声。
examples.py: Diàntī lǐ bú yào shuōhuà tài dàshēng.
examples.en: Don't talk too loudly in the elevator.

breakdown: 电子(electronic)+邮件(mail) — electronic mail

examples.py: Wǒ gěi nǐ fā diànzǐ yóujiàn.
examples.en: I'll send you an email.

examples.cn: 我收到了他的电子邮件。
examples.py: Wǒ shōu dào le tā de diànzǐ yóujiàn.
examples.en: I received his email.
Please take a look at the email.

examples.cn: 我每天写很多电子邮件。
examples.py: Wǒ měitiān xiě hěn duō diànzǐ yóujiàn.
examples.en: I write many emails every day.

examples.cn: 他的电子邮件我还没回。
examples.py: Tā de diànzǐ yóujiàn wǒ hái méi huí.
examples.en: I haven't replied to his email yet.

breakdown: Whole shape — think of the sun rising behind a tree

examples.en: The sun comes up from the east.

examples.py: Wǒ jiā zài chéngshì de dōngbiān.
examples.en: My home is on the east side of the city.

examples.py: Wǎng dōng zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.en: Walk east for five minutes and you're there.
There is a park on the east side.

examples.cn: 这个房间是东南方向的。
examples.py: Zhège fángjiān shì dōngnán fāngxiàng de.
examples.en: This room faces southeast.

breakdown: 夂(walk slowly)+丶丶(two ice dots) — the ice dots at the bottom mean cold

examples.en: Winter is very cold.
I don't like winter.

examples.cn: 冬天的时候要多穿衣服。
examples.py: Dōngtiān de shíhou yào duō chuān yīfu.
examples.en: In winter you should wear more clothes.
Winter in the north is especially long.
After winter comes spring.

breakdown: 动(move)+物(thing) — a thing that moves

examples.en: I like small animals.

examples.py: Dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù.
examples.en: There are many animals in the zoo.

examples.py: Xióngmāo shì hěn kě'ài de dòngwù.
examples.en: Pandas are very cute animals.

examples.py: Zhè zhǒng dòngwù hěn shǎo jiàn.
examples.en: This kind of animal is rarely seen.
We should take good care of animals.

breakdown: 矢(arrow)+豆(bean) — an arrow measured against a short bean

examples.py: Zhè tiáo kùzi tài duǎn le.
examples.en: These trousers are too short.
Her hair is very short.

examples.py: Shíjiān tài duǎn, zuò bu wán.
examples.en: The time is too short, I can't finish.
This story is very short.
Days in winter are fairly short.

khmer: កថាខណ្ឌ / ចន្លោះ
breakdown: Whole shape — a piece cut from something longer

examples.en: Please read the first paragraph.
This stretch of road is very long.

examples.cn: 过了一段时间他回来了。
examples.py: Guò le yí duàn shíjiān tā huílái le.
examples.en: After a period of time he came back.

examples.py: Zhè duàn huà wǒ bù míngbai.
examples.en: I don't understand this passage.
The article has five paragraphs in total.

breakdown: 锻(forge metal, 钅metal radical)+炼(refine by fire, 火fire radical) — forging your body like metal

examples.en: I exercise every morning.
Exercise is very good for the body.
You should exercise more.
He exercises in the park.

examples.cn: 锻炼以后我觉得很舒服。
examples.py: Duànliàn yǐhòu wǒ juéde hěn shūfu.
examples.en: After exercising I feel very comfortable.

khmer: យ៉ាងណា / ខ្លាំងណាស់
breakdown: 多(many, much)+么(particle) — used to exclaim 'how much!'

examples.en: What lovely weather!
How quiet this place is!
Look, how hard he works!
What a cute child!

examples.cn: 我不知道这件事多么重要。
examples.py: Wǒ bù zhīdào zhè jiàn shì duōme zhòngyào.
examples.en: I didn't know how important this was.

breakdown: 饣(food radical)+我(sound wǒ/è) — food radical shows it is about eating

examples.en: I'm hungry.
Are you hungry?

examples.py: È de shíhou bié chī tài kuài.
examples.en: When you're hungry don't eat too fast.

examples.cn: 我早上没吃饭，现在很饿。
examples.py: Wǒ zǎoshang méi chīfàn, xiànzài hěn è.
examples.en: I didn't eat in the morning, now I'm very hungry.

examples.py: Háizi è le jiù huì kū.
examples.en: When a child is hungry it will cry.

breakdown: 耳(ear, a picture of an ear)+朵(measure word for soft things)

examples.en: My ear hurts.

examples.py: Xiǎo gǒu de ěrduo hěn dà.
examples.en: The puppy's ears are very big.
Please listen with your ears.

examples.py: Tā de ěrduo bú tài hǎo.
examples.en: His hearing isn't very good.

examples.py: Tiān tài lěng, ěrduo dōu hóng le.
examples.en: It's so cold my ears have turned red.

khmer: ផ្ញើ / បញ្ចេញ
breakdown: Whole shape — read fā for 'send', fà for 'hair'

examples.cn: 我给他发了一个电子邮件。
examples.py: Wǒ gěi tā fā le yí ge diànzǐ yóujiàn.
examples.en: I sent him an email.
Please send it to me.
The teacher handed out new textbooks.

examples.py: Tā fā le hěn duō zhàopiàn.
examples.en: He posted a lot of photos.

examples.py: Wǒ hái méi fā zhè tiáo xiāoxi.
examples.en: I haven't sent this message yet.

breakdown: 发(give off)+烧(burn, 火fire radical) — the body giving off heat

examples.en: I have a fever.
If a child has a fever you should go to the hospital.
He has had a fever for three days.

examples.py: Gǎnmào yǐhòu wǒ jiù fāshāo le.
examples.en: After catching a cold I got a fever.

examples.py: Nǐ fāshāo le, kuài xiūxi ba.
examples.en: You have a fever, go rest quickly.

breakdown: 发(send out, bring out)+现(appear) — bring into appearance

examples.py: Wǒ fāxiàn le yí ge wèntí.
examples.en: I found a problem.
He discovered he was wrong.
I found that it's very quiet here.
Did you discover anything?

examples.cn: 我们发现了一个好地方。
examples.py: Wǒmen fāxiàn le yí ge hǎo dìfang.
examples.en: We found a nice place.

breakdown: 方(way, method)+便(convenient) — an easy way

examples.en: It's very convenient here.
Taking the subway is very convenient.
When is convenient for you?

examples.py: Zhù zài xuéxiào pángbiān hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.en: Living next to the school is very convenient.

examples.py: Shǒujī ràng shēnghuó gèng fāngbiàn le.
examples.en: Phones have made life more convenient.

khmer: ស្ងប់ចិត្ត
breakdown: 放(put down)+心(heart) — put your heart down

examples.en: Don't worry.

examples.cn: 妈妈不放心我一个人去。
examples.py: Māma bú fàngxīn wǒ yí ge rén qù.
examples.en: Mom isn't comfortable with me going alone.

examples.cn: 听到这个消息我就放心了。
examples.py: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi wǒ jiù fàngxīn le.
examples.en: Hearing this news I felt relieved.

examples.py: Qǐng fàngxīn, wǒ huì xiǎoxīn de.
examples.en: Rest assured, I will be careful.

examples.py: Tā zuò shì wǒ hěn fàngxīn.
examples.en: I feel confident about the way he does things.

english: minute; to divide; point (in a score)
breakdown: 八(split)+刀(knife) — a knife splitting something

examples.en: It's ten past eight now.
Please divide the cake.
I scored ninety points.

examples.py: Wǒmen fēn chéng liǎng ge bān.
examples.en: We are divided into two classes.
Wait five more minutes.

breakdown: 附(attach to)+近(near) — attached and near

examples.en: Is there a supermarket nearby?
It's very quiet near my home.

examples.py: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu hěn duō fàndiàn.
examples.en: There are many restaurants near the school.
He lives right nearby.
There is no subway station nearby.

khmer: ត្រួតពិនិត្យឡើងវិញ
breakdown: 复(again)+习(practice) — practice again

examples.en: I need to review my lessons.
You should review before the exam.

examples.py: Tā měitiān fùxí yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: He reviews for one hour every day.
Let's review together.

examples.cn: 复习了以后我就明白了。
examples.py: Fùxí le yǐhòu wǒ jiù míngbai le.
examples.en: After reviewing I understood.

breakdown: 干(dry)+净(clean) — dry and clean

examples.en: The room is very clean.
Please wash your hands clean.

examples.cn: 打扫以后房间干净多了。
examples.py: Dǎsǎo yǐhòu fángjiān gānjìng duō le.
examples.en: After cleaning the room is much cleaner.

examples.cn: 这家饭店又干净又便宜。
examples.py: Zhè jiā fàndiàn yòu gānjìng yòu piányi.
examples.en: This restaurant is both clean and cheap.
He ate everything up.

english: to catch a cold; a cold
breakdown: 感(feel)+冒(give off) — the body feeling and giving off illness

examples.en: I caught a cold.
It's easy to catch a cold in cold weather.

examples.py: Gǎnmào le yào duō hē shuǐ.
examples.en: When you have a cold you should drink more water.

examples.py: Tā gǎnmào le, méi lái shàngkè.
examples.en: He caught a cold and didn't come to class.
My cold is better.

khmer: ចាប់អារម្មណ៍
breakdown: 感(feel)+兴趣(interest) — to feel interest

examples.en: I'm interested in history.

examples.py: Tā duì yīnyuè hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.en: He is very interested in music.
What are you interested in?
I'm not very interested.

examples.py: Hěn duō rén duì Zhōngwén gǎn xìngqù.
examples.en: Many people are interested in Chinese.

khmer: អម្បាញ់មិញ
breakdown: 刚(just)+才(only then) — only just now

examples.en: He came just now.
What did you say just now?
I was taking a shower a moment ago.
The meeting just now was very long.

examples.cn: 刚才还在这儿，现在不见了。
examples.py: Gāngcái hái zài zhèr, xiànzài bú jiàn le.
examples.en: It was here a moment ago, now it's gone.

breakdown: 个(individual)+子(noun suffix) — a person's size

examples.en: He is very tall.

examples.py: Tā de gèzi bǐ wǒ ǎi.
examples.en: She is shorter than me.
How tall are you?

examples.cn: 他个子不高，可是很聪明。
examples.py: Tā gèzi bù gāo, kěshì hěn cōngming.
examples.en: He isn't tall, but he is very clever.

examples.py: Dǎ qiú de rén gèzi dōu hěn gāo.
examples.en: People who play ball are all tall.

breakdown: 根(root)+据(basis) — the root and basis of something

examples.py: Gēnjù tiānqì, míngtiān huì xià yǔ.
examples.en: According to the weather, it will rain tomorrow.

examples.cn: 根据老师说的，考试很难。
examples.py: Gēnjù lǎoshī shuō de, kǎoshì hěn nán.
examples.en: According to what the teacher said, the exam is hard.
What you say has no basis.

examples.cn: 根据这张地图，我们走错了。
examples.py: Gēnjù zhè zhāng dìtú, wǒmen zǒu cuò le.
examples.en: According to this map, we went the wrong way.
Choose based on the results.

khmer: ជាមួយ / តាម
breakdown: 足(foot radical)+艮 — the foot radical shows following on foot

examples.en: I'll go together with him.
Please follow me.
Who are you talking with?
This one is the same as that one.
The child walks following mom.

breakdown: Whole shape — read gèng for 'even more'

examples.en: Today is even colder.
He works even harder than me.
This method is even simpler.

examples.py: Fùxí yǐhòu wǒ gèng míngbai le.
examples.en: After reviewing I understand even better.
I like drinking tea even more.

breakdown: 公(public, metric)+斤(a Chinese weight unit) — the metric version of 斤

examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng gōngjīn shuǐguǒ.
examples.en: I bought two kilograms of fruit.
This box weighs ten kilograms.
How many kilograms do you weigh?
How much is one kilogram of rice?
He lost three kilograms.

breakdown: 故(old, past)+事(matter) — a matter from the past

examples.en: I like listening to stories.
This story is very interesting.
Mom tells me stories.

examples.py: Zhè běn shū lǐ yǒu hěn duō gùshi.
examples.en: There are many stories in this book.

examples.py: Gùshi de zuìhòu tā huí jiā le.
examples.en: At the end of the story he went home.

english: to be windy; the wind blows
breakdown: 刮(scrape, 刂knife radical)+风(wind) — wind scraping past

examples.en: It's windy today.
There's a strong wind outside.
Don't go out when it's windy.

examples.py: Zuótiān yòu guāfēng yòu xià yǔ.
examples.en: Yesterday it was both windy and rainy.
It's often windy in autumn.

breakdown: Whole shape — think of a gate being shut

examples.en: Please close the door.
Turn off the light when you leave.
What time does the supermarket close?
Please turn off the TV.
The window isn't closed properly.

khmer: ទំនាក់ទំនង
breakdown: 关(connect, close)+系(tie together) — things tied together

examples.en: Their relationship is very good.
It doesn't matter.

examples.py: Zhè liǎng jiàn shì méiyǒu guānxi.
examples.en: These two things are unrelated.
My relationship with him is ordinary.

examples.py: Zhè gēn nǐ yǒu guānxi ma?
examples.en: Does this have anything to do with you?

english: to care about; be concerned about
khmer: យកចិត្តទុកដាក់
breakdown: 关(connect)+心(heart) — your heart is connected to it

examples.en: Thank you for your concern.
Parents care a lot about their children.
He cares about his colleagues.
We should care about our health.

examples.py: Méiyǒu rén guānxīn zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: Nobody cares about this matter.

breakdown: 关(connect)+于(at, to) — connected to a topic

examples.py: Zhè shì guānyú lìshǐ de shū.
examples.en: This is a book about history.

examples.py: Guānyú zhè jiàn shì, wǒ bù zhīdào.
examples.en: Regarding this matter, I don't know.

examples.cn: 他讲了关于中国文化的事。
examples.py: Tā jiǎng le guānyú Zhōngguó wénhuà de shì.
examples.en: He talked about Chinese culture.

examples.cn: 关于考试的问题请问老师。
examples.py: Guānyú kǎoshì de wèntí qǐng wèn lǎoshī.
examples.en: For questions about the exam please ask the teacher.

examples.cn: 我看了一个关于动物的节目。
examples.py: Wǒ kàn le yí ge guānyú dòngwù de jiémù.
examples.en: I watched a program about animals.

breakdown: 国(country)+家(home) — the country is the big home

examples.py: Zhōngguó shì yí ge dà guójiā.
examples.en: China is a big country.

examples.py: Nǐ shì nǎge guójiā de rén?
examples.en: Which country are you from?

examples.py: Wǒ qù guo sān ge guójiā.
examples.en: I have been to three countries.

examples.cn: 每个国家的文化都不一样。
examples.py: Měi ge guójiā de wénhuà dōu bù yíyàng.
examples.en: Every country's culture is different.

examples.cn: 这个国家很小，可是很干净。
examples.py: Zhège guójiā hěn xiǎo, kěshì hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: This country is small, but very clean.

english: in the past; to go over
breakdown: 过(pass)+去(go) — time that has gone past

examples.en: In the past I lived in Beijing.

examples.py: Guòqù de shì jiù bié xiǎng le.
examples.en: Don't think about the past.
I'll walk over and take a look.
In the past there was no subway here.

examples.py: Guòqù liǎng nián tā biànhuà hěn dà.
examples.en: He has changed a lot in the past two years.

breakdown: 还(still)+是(be) — still is; also used for 'or'

examples.py: Nǐ hē chá háishi hē shuǐ?
examples.en: Do you drink tea or water?
We'd better go.
He still hasn't come.
Are you going or am I?

examples.cn: 外面下雨，还是别出去了。
examples.py: Wàimiàn xià yǔ, háishi bié chūqù le.
examples.en: It's raining outside, better not go out.

breakdown: 害(harm)+怕(fear, 忄heart radical) — the heart fearing harm

examples.en: I'm very scared.
Don't be afraid, I'm here.
He is afraid of exams.
The child is afraid of the dark.
I'm afraid of saying the wrong thing.

breakdown: 黑(black)+板(board) — a black board

examples.py: Lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shàng xiě zì.
examples.en: The teacher writes on the blackboard.
Please look at the blackboard.

examples.py: Hēibǎn shàng yǒu hěn duō Hànzì.
examples.en: There are many characters on the blackboard.
Can someone wipe the blackboard?

examples.cn: 我坐得远，看不清楚黑板。
examples.py: Wǒ zuò de yuǎn, kàn bu qīngchu hēibǎn.
examples.en: I sit far away and can't see the blackboard clearly.

breakdown: 后(after)+来(come) — what came after

What happened afterwards?

examples.py: Hòulái wǒmen chéng le hǎo péngyou.
examples.en: Later we became good friends.

examples.cn: 我先去了学校，后来去了图书馆。
examples.py: Wǒ xiān qù le xuéxiào, hòulái qù le túshūguǎn.
examples.en: I first went to school, then later to the library.

examples.py: Hòulái de shì wǒ bù qīngchu.
examples.en: I'm not clear about what happened later.

khmer: លិខិតឆ្លងដែន
breakdown: 护(protect)+照(certificate) — a document that protects you abroad

examples.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ kàn nǐ de hùzhào.
examples.en: Please show me your passport.
I lost my passport.
You need to bring a passport to go abroad.

examples.py: Hùzhào zài wǒ de bāo lǐ.
examples.en: The passport is in my bag.

examples.py: Bàn hùzhào yào duō cháng shíjiān?
examples.en: How long does it take to get a passport?

khmer: ផ្កា / ចំណាយ
breakdown: 艹(grass radical)+化(sound huà) — plant radical plus the 'hua' sound

examples.en: These flowers are very pretty.
Flowers bloom in spring.

examples.py: Wǒ huā le hěn duō qián.
examples.en: I spent a lot of money.

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì huā le wǒ sān tiān.
examples.en: This took me three days.

examples.cn: 他买了一些花送给妈妈。
examples.py: Tā mǎi le yìxiē huā sòng gěi māma.
examples.en: He bought some flowers for his mom.

khmer: គូរ / រូបគំនូរ
breakdown: Whole shape — a hand drawing lines inside a frame

examples.en: I like drawing.
This painting is very famous.
He draws very well.
Please draw an animal.

examples.py: Qiáng shàng yǒu yì zhāng dà huà.
examples.en: There is a big painting on the wall.

breakdown: 环(ring, surround)+境(area, border) — the area surrounding you

examples.en: The environment here is very good.
We should protect the environment.
The study environment is very important.

examples.cn: 新的环境让我很不习惯。
examples.py: Xīn de huánjìng ràng wǒ hěn bù xíguàn.
examples.en: The new environment feels unfamiliar to me.

examples.cn: 这个城市的环境变化很大。
examples.py: Zhège chéngshì de huánjìng biànhuà hěn dà.
examples.en: This city's environment has changed a lot.

breakdown: 黄(yellow)+河(river) — the yellow river

examples.en: The Yellow River is very long.
I want to go see the Yellow River.
The Yellow River is in northern China.

examples.py: Guānyú Huánghé yǒu hěn duō gùshi.
examples.en: There are many stories about the Yellow River.

examples.cn: 黄河对中国历史很重要。
examples.py: Huánghé duì Zhōngguó lìshǐ hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: The Yellow River is very important to Chinese history.

breakdown: 几(how many, a few)+乎(particle) — down to just a few, so 'almost'

examples.en: I almost arrived late.
He exercises almost every day.

examples.py: Zhè běn shū wǒ jīhū kàn wán le.
examples.en: I have almost finished this book.
There is almost nobody in the classroom.

examples.py: Wǒ jīhū wàngjì zhè jiàn shì le.
examples.en: I almost forgot about this.
